properties.name: app.jwt.secret
properties.description: Secret key used to sign and verify JWT access and refresh tokens (HS256, minimum 256 bits).

properties.name: app.cors.allowed-origins
properties.description: Comma-separated list of origins allowed to call the API from a browser.

properties.name: app.ratelimit.capacity
properties.description: Requests allowed per client address per period on the auth endpoints.

properties.name: app.ratelimit.period-seconds
properties.description: Length of the rate-limiting window in seconds.

properties.name: app.ratelimit.trust-forwarded-header
properties.description: Whether to read the client address from X-Forwarded-For. Enable only behind a trusted proxy.
